name: Usami Ren
source:
The wife of the main character, Jin.
She also helps out at the main character's coffee shop.
Her maiden name is Endo.
She used to be distrustful of men because of her many experiences of being molested,
However, she fell in love at first sight with Jin when he saved her from being molested for the first time.
Despite the age difference between them, they developed a relationship through their love for each other.
They were married without incident.
Although she is married, she is currently a college student, and after graduation she plans to support her husband's café.
She is still afraid of men other than her husband because she was a habitual victim of molestation.
She would like to have a child.
